market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$78k requires a -42% drawdown from current levels by year-end (8 months). Recent stress only took it to ~$65-70k zone before recovery. Bear-case analyst targets cluster $46-55k, slightly above $45k. Historical post-halving cycles can produce 70%+ drawdowns but the institutional/ETF era has dampened amplitude. Real but moderate tail risk.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro recession or ETF outflow cascade could trigger; conversely strong institutional bid floor near $65-70k may hold.
